svg.text: Campus wi-fi does not fail, it hangs. Vertex gives the network 2.5 seconds, then
draws the map already sitting on your phone.
No app store and no account. Open the link and add it to your home screen.
163 buildings, 25 places to eat, and 7 CUE routes across 26 stops.
An independent student project. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by George Mason University.
